svg.title: Route each key to its owning shard
svg.desc: Four range-keyed drawers with a routing selector. Each shard owns one illustrated user-ID range. User 42 belongs to Shard 1.
svg.text: Route each key to its owning shard
User IDs 25–49 belong to Shard 1. The illustrated user_id = 42 routes here.
User IDs 75–99 belong to Shard 3. These ranges are an example partition rule.
Each shard owns one illustrated user-ID range. User 42 belongs to Shard 1.
